Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for UT Administration of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Guest Lecturer posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Guest Lecturer posts is scheduled for 06 August 2026. Candidates are advised to report at the venue on this date with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Guest Lecturer positions?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduate Degree with a minimum of 55% marks. Additionally, they should have qualified NET/SET/SLET or hold a Ph.D. degree in the relevant subject.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Guest Lecturer posts?
faq.answer: A total of 12 vacancies are available for the Guest Lecturer positions across various subjects like Botany, Chemistry, English, Mathematics, and Zoology.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for these recruitment posts?
faq.answer: There is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for these Guest Lecturer recruitment posts. Candidates can attend the walk-in interview without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Guest Lecturer positions?
faq.answer: The salary for Guest Lecturers is structured per lecture, with a maximum monthly earning of ₹25,000. The rate is ₹1000 per lecture.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application for these Guest Lecturer positions is through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at the UT Administration of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu. The exact venue address is Daman, Pincode: 396210.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies, recent passport-size photographs, and a duly filled application form if required.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any age limit for the Guest Lecturer posts?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify a minimum or maximum age limit for these Guest Lecturer positions. Candidates are advised to refer to the detailed notification for any specific age criteria.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Guest Lecturer recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Guest Lecturer recruitment involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification. Candidates who perform well in the interview will be considered for the positions.
